title: Fake DocuSign Contract
scenario: A contract-signing email sends staff to a login page outside the expected domain.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.C: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Fake DocuSign Contract: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Document signing should be verified through known platforms and sender channels.
